newsitem.title: ITALY: Sicilian court sentences 79 Mafia family members.
newsitem.headline: Sicilian court sentences 79 Mafia family members.

text.p: A Sicilian court on Wednesday convicted 79 members of a Mafia family on a variety of charges and sentenced them to jail terms ranging from one to 22 years.
The members of the Santapaola clan were convicted on charges of Mafia association, armed robbery, drug trafficking and extortion. Their combined sentences totalled 530 years in jail.
The trial, which opened 10 months ago in the eastern Sicilian town of Catania, involved a number of defendants already serving sentences for other convictions.

Clan leader Nitto Santapaola was not involved in the trial that ended on Wednesday. He is being tried in a separate case along with another 73 defendants charged with various crimes, including 22 murders.
